sentences.text: Lisinopril is used to treat high blood pressure.
sentences.quote: Lisinopril tablets, USP, are indicated for the treatment of hypertension in adult patients and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older to lower blood pressure.

sentences.text: It is also used with other treatments for heart failure.
sentences.quote: Adjunct therapy for heart failure (1.2)

sentences.text: It is also used after a heart attack in people whose condition is stable.
sentences.quote: indicated for the reduction of mortality in treatment of hemodynamically stable patients within 24 hours of acute myocardial infarction.

sentences.text: The doctor may change the amount based on how blood pressure responds.
sentences.quote: Dosage should be adjusted according to blood pressure response.

sentences.text: Do not use salt substitutes that have potassium unless the doctor says it is okay.
sentences.quote: Tell patients not to use salt substitutes containing potassium without consulting their physician.

sentences.text: Heavy sweating, dehydration, vomiting, or diarrhea can make blood pressure drop too low.
sentences.quote: Tell patients that excessive perspiration and dehydration may lead to an excessive fall in blood pressure because of reduction in fluid volume.

sentences.text: In people treated for high blood pressure, common side effects were headache, dizziness and cough.
sentences.quote: Hypertension: headache, dizziness and cough (6.1)

sentences.text: In people with heart failure, low blood pressure and chest pain were common.
sentences.quote: Heart Failure: hypotension and chest pain (6.1)

sentences.text: Tell the doctor about any light-headedness, especially in the first few days.
sentences.quote: Tell patients to report light-headedness especially during the first few days of therapy.

sentences.text: Report right away any swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat, or any trouble swallowing or breathing.
sentences.quote: Tell patients to report immediately any signs or symptoms suggesting angioedema (swelling of face, extremities, eyes, lips, tongue, difficulty in swallowing or breathing)

sentences.text: If fainting happens, talk with the doctor before taking more.
sentences.quote: If actual syncope occurs, tell the patient to discontinue the drug until they have consulted with the prescribing physician.

sentences.text: Report signs of infection, like a sore throat or fever, promptly.
sentences.quote: Tell patients to report promptly any indication of infection (e.g., sore throat, fever), which may be a sign of leukopenia/neutropenia.

sentences.text: This medicine can harm an unborn baby, so tell the doctor about a pregnancy.
sentences.quote: Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus

sentences.text: The label says older people may be more sensitive to this medicine.
sentences.quote: greater sensitivity of some older individuals cannot be ruled out.

sentences.text: Spironolactone is used to treat serious heart failure.
sentences.quote: The treatment of NYHA Class III-IV heart failure and reduced ejection fraction to increase survival, manage edema, and to reduce the need for hospitalization for heart failure

sentences.text: It can be added to other medicines to help lower high blood pressure.
sentences.quote: Use as an add-on therapy for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure.

sentences.text: It is also used for swelling from extra fluid in some adults with liver problems.
sentences.quote: The management of edema in adult patients who are cirrhotic when edema is not responsive to fluid and sodium restrictions

sentences.text: It can be taken with or without food.
sentences.quote: Spironolactone tablets can be taken with or without food, but should be taken consistently with respect to food

sentences.text: The person should avoid potassium supplements and foods high in potassium, including salt substitutes.
sentences.quote: should be advised to avoid potassium supplements and foods containing high levels of potassium, including salt substitutes.

sentences.text: The most common side effect is breast growth in men, called gynecomastia.
sentences.quote: The most common adverse reaction with spironolactone treatment is gynecomastia

sentences.text: Some people may have an upset stomach, throwing up, diarrhea or cramping.
sentences.quote: Digestive: Gastric bleeding, ulceration, gastritis, diarrhea and cramping, nausea, vomiting.

sentences.text: Some people have had dizziness, headache, sleepiness or confusion.
sentences.quote: Nervous system/psychiatric: Lethargy, mental confusion, ataxia, dizziness, headache, drowsiness.

sentences.text: It can raise the potassium level in the blood, which is a serious risk.
sentences.quote: Spironolactone can cause hyperkalemia.

sentences.text: This risk is higher for people with kidney problems or who take certain other medicines.
sentences.quote: This risk is increased by impaired renal function or concomitant potassium supplementation, potassium-containing salt substitutes or drugs that increase potassium

sentences.text: Losing too much fluid can cause dehydration, low blood pressure and worse kidney function.
sentences.quote: Excessive diuresis may cause symptomatic dehydration, hypotension and worsening renal function

sentences.text: Older adults are more likely to have weaker kidneys, so their kidneys should be checked.
sentences.quote: Because elderly patients are more likely to have decreased renal function, monitor renal function.

sentences.text: It should not be used by people who have high potassium or Addison's disease, or who take eplerenone.
sentences.quote: Spironolactone is contraindicated in the patients with: Hyperkalemia Addison’s disease Concomitant use of eplerenone

sentences.text: Warfarin helps prevent and treat blood clots in the veins and lungs.
sentences.quote: Prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis and its extension, pulmonary embolism (PE).

sentences.text: It is also used for clot problems linked to atrial fibrillation or a heart valve replacement.
sentences.quote: Prophylaxis and treatment of thromboembolic complications associated with atrial fibrillation (AF) and/or cardiac valve replacement.

sentences.text: After a heart attack, it helps lower the risk of death, another heart attack, and clots such as stroke.
sentences.quote: Reduction in the risk of death, recurrent myocardial infarction (MI), and thromboembolic events such as stroke or systemic embolization after myocardial infarction.

sentences.text: The label says to take warfarin exactly as prescribed.
sentences.quote: Take warfarin sodium exactly as prescribed.

sentences.text: If a dose is missed, take it as soon as possible on the same day, but do not take a double dose the next day.
sentences.quote: If the prescribed dose of warfarin sodium is missed, take the dose as soon as possible on the same day but do not take a double dose of warfarin sodium the next day to make up for missed doses

sentences.text: Regular blood tests and visits with the healthcare provider are needed to check on treatment.
sentences.quote: You must have regular blood tests and visits with your healthcare provider to monitor your condition.

sentences.text: The label says to eat a normal, balanced diet so the amount of vitamin K stays steady.
sentences.quote: Eat a normal, balanced diet to maintain a consistent intake of vitamin K.

sentences.text: The most common side effect is bleeding, and it can be serious.
sentences.quote: Most common adverse reactions to warfarin sodium are fatal and nonfatal hemorrhage from any tissue or organ.

sentences.text: Stomach upsets can happen, such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and bloating.
sentences.quote: Gastrointestinal disorders: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, taste perversion, abdominal pain, flatulence, bloating

sentences.text: Skin problems such as rash, itching, or hair loss may also happen.
sentences.quote: Skin disorders: rash, dermatitis (including bullous eruptions), pruritus, alopecia

sentences.text: Warfarin can cause major bleeding, which can even be fatal.
sentences.quote: Warfarin sodium can cause major or fatal bleeding

sentences.text: Tell the doctor right away about any unusual bleeding or other unusual symptoms.
sentences.quote: Notify their physician immediately if any unusual bleeding or symptoms occur.

sentences.text: The label says to avoid activities or sports that could cause an injury.
sentences.quote: Avoid any activity or sport that may result in traumatic injury

sentences.text: Older people taking warfarin need closer checks for bleeding.
sentences.quote: Conduct more frequent monitoring for bleeding with administration of warfarin sodium to elderly patients in any situation or with any physical condition where added risk of hemorrhage is present.

sentences.text: Sertraline is used to treat major depressive disorder.
sentences.quote: Sertraline hydrochloride tablets are indicated for the treatment of the following [See Clinical Studies (14) ] : Major depressive disorder (MDD)

sentences.text: It is also used for panic disorder, social anxiety disorder, and OCD.
sentences.quote: Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) Panic disorder (PD) Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) Social anxiety disorder (SAD)

sentences.text: Sertraline is part of a group of medicines called SSRIs.
sentences.quote: Sertraline hydrochloride tablets are a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) indicated for the treatment of ( 1 )

sentences.text: When stopping this medicine, the dose should be lowered slowly, not all at once, whenever possible.
sentences.quote: Gradually reduce the dosage rather than stopping sertraline hydrochloride tablets abruptly whenever possible.

sentences.text: Patients should not stop suddenly and should talk with their healthcare provider about how to taper.
sentences.quote: Advise patients not to abruptly discontinue sertraline hydrochloride and to discuss any tapering regimen with their healthcare provider.

sentences.text: Tell the healthcare provider about any medicines that raise the risk of bleeding, including ones bought without a prescription.
sentences.quote: Advise patients to inform their health care providers if they are taking or planning to take any prescription or over-the-counter medications that increase the risk of bleeding

sentences.text: The most common side effects are nausea, diarrhea or loose stools, and tremor.
sentences.quote: were nausea, diarrhea/loose stool, tremor, dyspepsia, decreased appetite, hyperhidrosis, ejaculation failure, and decreased libido

sentences.text: Other side effects people may notice are dry mouth, tiredness, dizziness, sleepiness, and trouble sleeping.
sentences.quote: Dry mouth 14% 9% Dyspepsia 8% 4% Constipation 6% 4% Vomiting 4% 1% General disorders and administration site conditions Fatigue 12% 8%

sentences.text: Sertraline may cause sexual problems in men and women, and a provider may be able to help.
sentences.quote: Talk to your healthcare provider if you develop any changes in your sexual function or if you have any questions or concerns about sexual problems during treatment with Sertraline hydrochloride tablets.

sentences.text: Watch closely for suicidal thoughts or behavior changes, especially early in treatment or when the dose is changed, and tell the provider.
sentences.quote: Advise patients and caregivers to look for the emergence of suicidality, especially early during treatment and when the dosage is adjusted up or down, and instruct them to report such symptoms to the healthcare provider

sentences.text: Serotonin syndrome can be life-threatening, and signs can include agitation, rigidity, and sweating.
sentences.quote: can precipitate serotonin syndrome, a potentially life-threatening condition.

sentences.text: It may raise the risk of bleeding, especially with aspirin, NSAIDs, or warfarin.
sentences.quote: Concomitant use of aspirin, nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), other antiplatelet drugs, warfarin, and other anticoagulants may add to this risk.

sentences.text: Older people may be more likely to have low blood sodium.
sentences.quote: have been associated with cases of clinically significant hyponatremia in elderly patients, who may be at greater risk for this adverse reaction

sentences.text: It should not be taken with an MAOI medicine, including the antibiotic linezolid, or with pimozide.
sentences.quote: Taking, or within 14 days of stopping, MAOIs, (including the MAOIs linezolid and intravenous methylene blue)

sentences.text: Metformin is used with diet and exercise to help control blood sugar in type 2 diabetes.
sentences.quote: indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus

sentences.text: The label says to take it with meals.
sentences.quote: given with meals

sentences.text: Before any surgery or X-ray procedure, tell the doctor about this medicine, because it may need to be paused for a while.
sentences.quote: Instruct patients to inform their doctor that they are taking metformin hydrochloride tablets prior to any surgical or radiological procedure, as temporary discontinuation may be required

sentences.text: The label advises against drinking a lot of alcohol while taking this medicine.
sentences.quote: Counsel patients against excessive alcohol intake and inform patients about importance of regular testing of renal function while receiving metformin hydrochloride tablets.

sentences.text: The most common side effects are stomach problems, like diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and gas.
sentences.quote: the most common adverse reactions (> 5.0%) are diarrhea, nausea/vomiting, flatulence, asthenia, indigestion, abdominal discomfort, and headache.

sentences.text: In studies, about 7% of patients had their vitamin B 12 levels drop below normal.
sentences.quote: a decrease to subnormal levels of previously normal serum vitamin B 12 levels was observed in approximately 7% of patients.

sentences.text: If lactic acidosis (a serious build-up of acid in the blood) is suspected, the medicine is stopped right away and the person is cared for in a hospital.
sentences.quote: If metformin-associated lactic acidosis is suspected, immediately discontinue metformin hydrochloride tablets and institute general supportive measures in a hospital setting.

sentences.text: Warning signs can include feeling unwell, muscle pain, trouble breathing, sleepiness, and stomach pain.
sentences.quote: nonspecific symptoms such as malaise, myalgias, respiratory distress, somnolence, and abdominal pain

sentences.text: If these signs appear, the label says to stop the medicine and tell the healthcare provider quickly.
sentences.quote: Advise patients to discontinue metformin hydrochloride tablets immediately and to promptly notify their healthcare provider if unexplained hyperventilation, myalgias, malaise, unusual somnolence or other nonspecific symptoms occur.

sentences.text: Older adults have a higher risk of lactic acidosis, so their kidneys should be checked more often.
sentences.quote: Assess renal function more frequently in elderly patients

sentences.text: The lisinopril label says that using it with diabetes medicines may increase their blood-sugar-lowering effect and risk low blood sugar.
sentences.quote: Concomitant administration of lisinopril and antidiabetic medicines (insulins, oral hypoglycemic agents) may cause an increased blood-glucose-lowering effect with risk of hypoglycemia.

sentences.text: The lisinopril label says potassium-sparing diuretics like spironolactone can raise the risk of high potassium.
sentences.quote: Potassium-sparing diuretics (spironolactone, amiloride, triamterene, and others) can increase the risk of hyperkalemia.

sentences.text: It says potassium levels should be monitored frequently if they are used together.
sentences.quote: if concomitant use of such agents is indicated, monitor the patient’s serum potassium frequently.

sentences.text: The spironolactone label lists ACE inhibitors, the class lisinopril belongs to, among drugs that can increase potassium.
sentences.quote: Examples of drugs that can increase potassium include: ACE inhibitors

sentences.text: It says that spironolactone with drugs that raise potassium may lead to severe high potassium.
sentences.quote: Concomitant administration of spironolactone with potassium supplementation or drugs that can increase potassium may lead to severe hyperkalemia.

sentences.text: The sertraline label names warfarin as a protein-bound drug and says to monitor for side effects when used with it.
sentences.quote: Monitor for adverse reactions and reduce dosage of sertraline hydrochloride or other protein-bound drugs (e.g., warfarin) as warranted.

sentences.text: The warfarin label lists sertraline among serotonin reuptake inhibitors that can increase bleeding risk.
sentences.quote: Table 3: Drugs that Can Increase the Risk of Bleeding

sentences.text: It says bleeding risk is higher when these drugs are used with warfarin, so patients should be closely monitored.
sentences.quote: Because bleeding risk is increased when these drugs are used concomitantly with warfarin, closely monitor patients receiving any such drug with warfarin.
